description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Damage Cap +10000], grants [Attach Dark 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Fire 2 with Stacking] depending on if the entry damage was Dark/Fire, [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Ardyn (Dark, Fire)]

description.name: Zenith Mode: Ardyn (Dark, Fire)
description.text: Increases [Fire/Dark Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Fire or Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time, critical chance =100% (max 5 turns), casts Spirit Attack: Ardyn after using a Fire or Dark ability (max 1 chase), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Aura of Darkness+
description.text: Five single ranged attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Ardyn
description.text: Grants [Critical Damage +50% 2], [Instant ATB 2], and [Instant Dark/Fire 2] to the user

description.name: Attach Dark 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
